The '''Sriluur system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained six [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Sriluur/Legends|Sriluur]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]] [[Ruul (moon)|Ruul]] and [[Quay]]. The asteroid belt [[Quay Lyn]] was located in this system, between the planets [[Alcrue]] and [[Lyntra]].
